name: Source Control
description: A username with a password or token, or an SSH key, used to clone a project's repository.

fields.label: Password or Token
fields.help_text: A password over HTTPS, or the personal access token a forge issues in place of one. A token may be supplied on its own, with no username.

fields.label: Private Key Passphrase
fields.help_text: Required only if the key above is encrypted.
